queries_run: Levi Strauss China tariff OR trade restriction sourcing 2026
apparel industry tariff exposure supply chain 2026

findings.claim: FY2026 10-Q：美國最高法院 2026-02-20 裁定 IEEPA 關稅無效；美國政府 2026-07-23 宣布依 Section 301 的新關稅；Q3 記錄 IEEPA 關稅退款 $78.6M。
findings.source: LEVI STRAUSS & CO Form 10-Q FY2026 (period ending 2026-08-30)
findings.excerpt: On February 20, 2026 a U.S. Supreme Court ruling invalidated the tariffs imposed by the U.S. government under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act; the U.S. government announced on July 23, 2026, new tariffs under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974.

findings.claim: 10-Q：多數產品產地（孟加拉、柬埔寨、巴基斯坦、越南）曾受被廢除的 IEEPA 關稅，且受新的預期關稅約束。
findings.excerpt: many of our products are produced in countries, such as Bangladesh, Cambodia, Pakistan, and Vietnam, that were subject to the invalidated U.S. IEEPA tariffs, and are subject to the new prospective tariffs.

findings.claim: Q3 營收約 +4%，關稅退款推升毛利率；全年調整後 EPS 預期上調，約 $60M 退款再投入業務。
findings.source: Hargreaves Lansdown / just-style: Levi Strauss lifts annual forecasts as strong demand cushions tariff hit
findings.excerpt: The revised guidance factors in the impact of IEEPA tariff refunds, with approximately $60m set to be redeployed into the business.

findings.claim: 中國占 Levi's 服裝產量約 1%（2018 年為 15%），主要產地為巴基斯坦、孟加拉、印尼等。
findings.source: Apparel Insider: Levi's to slash China sourcing amid trade war
findings.excerpt: It adjusted its set-up in response to the tariffs and the share that China now has of its garment production is approximately 1%.

findings.claim: 產業面：2026-02 IEEPA 被推翻後改為暫時性 10% Section 122 關稅（至 2026-07-24），其後 Section 301 新關稅（10%–12.5%、逾 80 國）自 2026-07-24 起；單一倡議團體來源，需對照官方公告。
findings.source: Business & Human Rights Resource Centre: tracking the impact of forced labour tariffs on apparel footwear supply chains

reg_tariff_export.note: as_of 10-Q 日期取公告期近似值（期末 2026-08-30，申報日未於摘要確認）；未找到 LEVI 的出口管制／實體清單相關事項（apparel 不適用性未自判）。第五條 excerpt 無逐字原文故為 null。
